insight: College commuters with oily skin struggle with sunscreens that feel greasy (46% of category complaints) or leave a chalky white cast. They need effective, high-SPF sun protection that feels light and fresh during outdoor transit without ruining their look.
key_message: Beat the heat and sun on your daily commute with Watermelon SPF 50—juicy, cooling sun protection with zero white cast and a weightless natural finish.

proof_points.text: Delivers outstanding texture and a natural, non-greasy finish that oily skin loves without heavy rubbing.
Absorbs smoothly with zero white cast, keeping skin looking fresh and selfie-ready.
Offers reliable SPF 50+ tan protection for outdoor activity and stays comfortable without stinging the eyes when you sweat.

persona: Ananya, 21 — college commuter in Delhi/Kolkata, navigating metro rides and autos daily with oily skin on a ₹400–600 budget.
tone: Juicy, upbeat, skin-smart, fruit-forward, and playful with short sentences.
